messages:
Sam (PS): Heads up: BetaCorp's POC ran a concurrency test and started getting 429s after ~40s of 100-120 req/s. Retry-After is 10s.
Maria (AE): Which route? streaming or non-stream?
Sam (PS): Streaming chat + occasional small completions. Requests are short (~150-300ms).
Alex (Eng): Looks like the tenant hit the per-route burst window. Their tenant is on default caps so bursts are limited.
Jen (Support): Filed SUP-4487 with logs and timestamps. Asked them to add exponential backoff + jitter right away.
Sam (PS): They need a one-off lift for tomorrow's demo. Any safe options?
Alex (Eng): Short-term we can: increase burst_tokens for their tenant on `chat.streaming` (e.g., 80 -> 300) and set a soft daily token budget with alerts. I can make the change if infra approves a 24-48h window.
Maria (AE): They worry about bill shock. Can we cap by tokens too?
Alex (Eng): Yes. Set daily_budget_tokens 400000 and hard stop at 600000, notify at 70/90%.
RatecapBot: Tenant betacorp: window usage peaked at 95% at 09:42:11 UTC. Suggest enabling client-side smoothing.
Jen (Support): Included a cost delta estimate in SUP-4487 and the admin API snippet. Waiting on infra approval.
Sam (PS): I'll ask BetaCorp to stagger their runners as fallback. Also requested they send a unique header `X-POC-Run-Id` to help trace.
Alex (Eng): Note: streaming multiplies connection churn; recommend batching prompts or using keep-alive.
Maria (AE): I'll coordinate test timing with them after infra reply.
Jen (Support): SUP-4487 updated; will post here once we get greenlight.
Sam (PS): Thanks — please ping this thread when approved so I can confirm the demo slot. :thumbsup:
